title: Interior and trunk storage space
summary: Feedback on storage centers on limited interior, console, door, and trunk space, while a few comments note good storage or ask for added solutions like a frunk.

positive.summary: Positive reviews mention generally good storage space, though examples are sparse.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe storage as reduced, shallow, awkward to use, and inadequate in the center console, door panels, and trunk.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews often mention wanting more storage or a frunk, but many fragments are too brief to confirm clear sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined or very brief, which limits confidence in specific theme interpretation.
Some examples are wish-list style requests for extra storage or a frunk rather than evaluations of existing storage performance.
The sample is drawn from a single model and mostly from US reviews, so it does not represent broader market feedback.
